QUOTE: It takes the remainder `ret & ~0xFF80`. If that is zero, it returns the high-level text alone. 6. Otherwise it appends `" : "` and the low-level text from `mbedtls_low_level_strerr()`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the high-level module part and low-level part of a code, and says both are rendered joined by " : " when both are present.
